name: Elit Atelier
tagline: Bespoke furniture with brass and marble

listing.description: A website for a premium furniture atelier: dark velvet with a golden glint, services and a finishes price list, order stages and booking via Telegram.

seo.title: Elit Atelier — premium bespoke furniture in Tashkent
seo.description: Tables with marble tops, chests and studies with brass hardware made to your sketches. Meetings at the atelier by appointment, production from 45 days.
seo.answer: Elit Atelier is a premium bespoke furniture atelier in Tashkent (12 Afrosiyob St), by appointment Mon–Sat 11:00–19:00. A dining table with a marble top from 42,000,000 UZS, a turnkey study from 120,000,000 UZS, production in 45–90 days, 5-year warranty.

sections.title: One-of-a-kind furniture
sections.subtitle: Marble, brass, walnut and leather. We design and make pieces to your sketch — and never repeat them for anyone.

sections.label: The atelier
sections.title: Twelve craftsmen and no assembly line
sections.text: One craftsman leads each order from the first sketch to installation. We polish brass by hand, choose marble slab by slab with you at the supplier’s yard and use only Italian leather. We take no more than forty orders a year.

items.title: Dining tables
items.text: A marble or travertine top on a brass or walnut base.

items.title: Studies and libraries
items.text: Wall panelling, a desk and lit cabinets — turnkey.

items.title: Chests and consoles
items.text: Walnut with brass hardware and a marble top.

items.title: Leather upholstered furniture
items.text: Sofas and armchairs to your dimensions in Italian leather.

items.title: Meeting at the atelier
items.text: Stone, metal and leather samples on one table.

items.title: Sketch and 3D
items.text: Two rounds at no extra charge.

items.title: Choosing the slab
items.text: We go to the yard and pick your piece of marble.

items.title: Installation
items.text: We deliver in gloves, place it and polish it on site.

items.quote: We picked the slab for the table ourselves — now it is the centrepiece of the house.
items.author: The Karimov family

items.quote: The study was done in 82 days, as promised. The brass still looks like day one.
items.author: Bakhtiyor

items.q: Can I come without an appointment?
items.a: Better to book: the meeting takes an hour and the craftsman prepares samples for your request.
60% after the 3D is approved, 40% before installation.
We seal it and give you a year’s supply of care product.

items.q: Do you work in other cities?
items.a: Yes, installation in Samarkand and Bukhara is included in the price.
